definitions.gloss: section; segment; interval (of a route or range)
definitions.explanation: A defined portion of a route, track, or range, often used for transportation routes, distance measurements, or mathematical intervals.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{区間|くかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工事中|こうじちゅう}→工事中：09625_koujichuu⟧だ。
⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{大阪|おおさか}→大阪：09779_oosaka⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{区間|くかん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧500⟦キロ→キロ：01350_kiro⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The section from Tokyo to Osaka is about 500 kilometers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高速道路|こうそくどうろ}→高速道路：09242_kousokudouro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{区間|くかん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{速度制限|そくどせいげん}→速度制限：15738_sokudoseigen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The speed limit was changed on some sections of the expressway.

notes:
In train timetables and announcements, {区間|くかん} marks the stretch of line that a delay, suspension or special service applies to. In mathematics it means an interval on a number line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {区間|くかん}⟦{運転|うんてん}→運転：01335_unten⟧ — service on only part of a line (e.g. after an accident)
- {区間|くかん}{快速|かいそく} — a train that runs as a rapid on part of its route and stops at every station elsewhere
- ⟦{運休|うんきゅう}→運休：06807_unkyuu⟧{区間|くかん} — the section where service is suspended
- {区間|くかん}{賞|しょう} — the best time on one leg of an ekiden relay

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{区域|くいき}→区域：00251_kuiki⟧ — an area or zone; {区間|くかん} is a stretch along a line
